result.title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
result.summary: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly. Explicit grounding substantially improves success and reaches state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks across three scene collections. We also correct annotation defects in these benchmarks, so that future methods are evaluated more faithfully. Our analysis on the clean benchmarks shows that, with ground-truth grounding, our policy nearly matches the expert that generated its demonstrations, leaving the headroom in perception rather than policy learning. Our work points to goal grounding as a missing piece of object-goal navigation and offers a simple and effective solution to the task.

AI.brief_summary: 论文诊断出 VLM 微调得到的物体目标导航策略主要失败于 goal grounding——常未察觉目标已在视野内、也难以估计距离；作者通过显式 grounding 提升成功率，在三个场景集六个基准上取得当时最优，并修正了基准中的标注缺陷。
AI.relevance_reason: 「未察觉目标已在视野内」与 STOP/LOOK 决策及任务必要视觉信息是否被策略保留有关，显式 grounding 近似于向策略注入视觉证据，「瓶颈在感知而非策略学习」的结论可供核查；但任务为具身导航，与 latent 视觉推理的联系较间接。
